questions: Does the patient currently have a fever (measured temperature ≥ 38°C)?
What is his oxygen saturation (SpO₂) on room air, if you have measured it?
Has the patient had wheezing or a high-pitched sound when breathing (stridor) or is the breathing effort worsening when lying flat or with activity?
What is his age and how fast is he breathing right now (count breaths for 30 seconds and multiply by 2)?
Has the patient had any chest pain or does breathing feel worse with deep breaths (pleuritic pain)?
Has the patient had any chest indrawing or trouble speaking/crying due to breathlessness?
Can you describe whether he has fast breathing with chest “pulling in” between the ribs or at the collarbone when he breathes?
Has a pulse oximeter reading of his oxygen saturation been measured, and if so what is the number on room air?
Has he had any fast or labored breathing—such as ribs pulling in (chest indrawing) or nostril flaring—at rest?
Has he had a doctor/listening exam finding of wheezing or crackles on one/both sides of the chest?
